metadata.title: Survey Identity and Anonymity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring survey respondent identity handling aligns with stated anonymity or confidentiality guarantees.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey identity models, response collection mechanisms, tracking tokens, metadata controls, and anonymization features.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing identity exposure, anonymity guarantees, and re-identification risk in survey systems.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Survey identity and anonymity controls assume baseline survey authority, purpose clarity, and response integrity.

metadata.remarks: Survey Identity and Anonymity defines trust properties required to ensure that survey identity handling matches claims made to respondents. This pattern addresses anonymity guarantees, pseudonymization, re-identification risk, and protection against hidden identity leakage.

components.title: Survey Identity Model Definition
components.description: Explicitly defines whether surveys are anonymous, pseudonymous, or identity-bound.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misrepresentation of survey anonymity or respondent identity handling.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to align system behavior with stated anonymity guarantees.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define allowable identity models for surveys.

components.title: Survey Anonymity Enforcement
components.description: Prevents direct attribution of responses when anonymity is promised.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of identifying information contrary to stated anonymity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Minimization and suppression of identity-bearing metadata.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls limit unnecessary disclosure of respondent identities.
Adaptive restrictions prevent identity leakage in anonymous surveys.

components.title: Survey De-anonymization Risk Management
components.description: Reduces re-identification risk from small populations or response combinations.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inference of respondent identity from survey response content or metadata.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Aggregation and suppression techniques to reduce re-identification risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey features are constrained to reduce unintended re-identification.

components.title: Survey Identity Auditability
components.description: Provides oversight into how survey identity and anonymity guarantees are implemented.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to identity handling violations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to validate adherence to anonymity commitments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit review supports verification of anonymity enforcement.
